summary.title: Release 0.6.1: ship the claude-code resume identity fix and the v7 migration column probe
summary.what: Two commits on main after merging community PRs #124 (odysseus0) and #125 (jiangge): (1) docs(migration) corrects the version attribution in #125's comments, the coverage column shipped in v0.3.15 (e8ff7e8 authored at package.json 0.3.14), not 0.4.4; (2) chore(release) bumps Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/package.json to 0.6.1, updates the site banner, footer and upgrade step title, the changelog footer, and adds the v0.6.1 changelog entry dated 2026-10-08 crediting both contributors.
summary.why: Both merged fixes are user-facing index blockers. A single Claude Code resume collapsed parent and resumed transcripts into one session and every sync rolled back with '1 source_files have stale next_seq', freezing all claude-code indexing. v7 indexes whose coverage table predates source_file_set_fingerprint could not migrate to v8 at all. 0.6.0 had just shipped, so a patch release gets both fixes to Homebrew and installer users.
summary.user_goal: Release 0.6.1: ship #124 (claude-code resume identity) and #125 (v7 migration column probe) with version bump, changelog, and site text

decisions.rationale: two bug fixes, no CLI or index contract change

decisions.point: How to land the external PRs
decisions.chose: GitHub merge commits with a short thank-you comment each
decisions.rationale: every prior PR on main landed as a merge commit

backups are single files produced by VACUUM INTO (no -wal/-shm sidecars), the newest stale copy and the fresh per-run backup are always kept, and the index is derived from raw transcripts; the USAGE.md promise that a backup is retained still holds

decisions.point: Wrong release version in #125's code comments
decisions.chose: separate docs commit before the bump instead of asking the contributor for another round
decisions.rationale: keeps the release commit purely mechanical and does not block the release
previous release commits never bumped it and npm ci passes

rejected.alternative: Request changes on #125 because remove_stale_backups is documented as never fatal but propagates read_dir/metadata I/O errors
rejected.reason: negligible in practice, a retry succeeds; not worth blocking a release

review_notes: #124 verified: its test alone on main fails with the exact 'index invariant check failed: 1 source_files have stale next_seq'; passes with the fix.
#125 verified: with main's migration code and the PR's tests, three tests fail, two with 'no such column: source_file_set_fingerprint'; all pass with the fix.

Gates on the bump commit: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --locked (216 + 13), npm run check (62), cargo build --release --locked, target/release/shlog --version prints 0.6.1 and status works, npm run eval:acceptance against the release binary exits 0.

On Claude Code 2.1.285 the resumed transcript's copied prefix already carries the new file's sessionId (646 shared record uuids across ~/.claude/projects); older/other paths keep the parent id. Filename identity covers both forms.
Release closeout steps after this seal: push main, wait for ci, annotated tag v0.6.1, release workflow, tap 'Update formula' workflow, wrangler deploy of site/, local PATH left at 0.6.0 unless asked.

behavioral_changes: sherlog.net banner, footer, upgrade step and changelog describe v0.6.1
migration_notes: No index migration in this seal. The merged #125 changes how a v7 database is fingerprinted during v7 -> v8 migration (COV13/COV14 marker) and trims stale .v7.bak.* backups older than 24h except the newest.
